description: This is a React component file implementing message action controls (like edit, copy, delete, resend, stop, pin) for a chat interface. It defines a MessageActions component that renders contextual action buttons for chat messages, with logic to handle message operations and UI interactions.

methods.name: deleteMessage
methods.description: Removes a message from the current session based on its ID.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Handles deletion of a specific message.

methods.name: onResend
methods.description: Handles resending a specific message, including finding related user/bot messages, deleting originals, and triggering a new user input.

methods.name: onPinMessage
methods.description: Pins a message to the session context and shows a toast with an option to set a prompt modal.

methods.name: onUserStop
methods.description: Sends a stop command to halt the current message generation.

methods.name: onEdit
methods.description: Allows editing of a message by prompting for new content and updating the message.

methods.name: onCopy
methods.description: Copies the message text content to clipboard.
